title: Audio Memo Routed Event
description: The fast in-car conversation layer decided one turn of a voice memo (one event per fast-model decision, including lexicon short-circuits and fall-backs to the agent). Part of the voice memo journey: correlationid = data.memo_id and ordering_key 'memo:<memo_id>'. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md.

s3_key.description: Object key of the voice memo: inbox/<agent>/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<file>.

target_agent_id.description: Agent the memo was addressed to (the inbox/<agent>/ prefix).

conv_id.description: Id of the fast in-car conversation session this memo belongs to.

action.description: The fast model's decision for this turn: reply, propose, confirm, cancel, end, direct or handoff (open set).

model_answered.description: The model that actually answered (response.model), not the one asked for.

route.description: Ladder rung that answered (e.g. r1, r2, r3).

attempts.description: Ladder rungs tried before the decision.

latency_ms.description: Wall time of the fast-model decision, in milliseconds.

usage.description: Token usage as the provider reported it.

cached_tokens.description: Prompt tokens served from the provider cache.

path.description: How the turn was decided: lexicon (short-circuit), fast (ladder) or direct (fallback to the agent).

fallback_reason.description: Why the turn went direct to the agent instead of through the fast model, when it did.
